description: Every language-model and Jev prompt in the runtime: a stable id, a version, its purpose, input and output contract, and a changelog. A prompt is the exact source of the declarations listed. Its fingerprint (prompts/fingerprint.mjs) must equal the latest changelog entry, so any change to a prompt needs a new version and changelog entry. runtimeVersion names the constant the runtime records with its output, where one exists.

prompts.purpose: System prompt of the legacy COMPOSE pass: how to word the reply to the customer from the decision already made (diagnosis, catalogue data, safety, presentation grain).
consumers: AC turns not under canonical control
prompts.input: Parts, model info, the normalised intent, the resolved fault, knowledge documents, safety stop, unsafe intent, normal behaviour, diagnose stop, committed diagnosis, presentation grain, conversation progress.
prompts.output: A system message (string). The model streams free text; the engine post-processes it (tripwire, identity and replacement-language constraints, safety copy).

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.

prompts.purpose: Per-intent nudges appended to the COMPOSE turn instruction, keyed by the validated userIntent enum.
consumers: AC turns not under canonical control
prompts.output: One sentence of guidance, or none.

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.

prompts.purpose: The COMPOSE conversation and final user-turn instruction: the customer conversation as the model sees it, and what to reply about now.
consumers: AC turns not under canonical control
prompts.input: Intent, fault, safety stop, unsafe intent, normal behaviour, the conversation messages, presentation.
prompts.output: An array of chat messages that follows the system prompt.

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.

prompts.purpose: Canonical COMPOSE: words one already-chosen NextAction from a typed brief. The output is checked; failures fall back to fixed templates.
consumers: AC turns under canonical control (allow-listed journeys)
prompts.input: A journey pack (task copy, conclusion copy, observation and check-result copy) and, per turn, cs/1 state, the NextAction and diagnostics.
prompts.output: System and user messages; the reply is validated by the pack (question count, no invented parts or model requests, required safety copy).

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.

prompts.purpose: The Jev UNDERSTAND question set: typed classification of the conversation (intent, family, identity, safety, symptom, customer evidence).
prompts.input: The conversation and conversation progress, sent as Jev state.
prompts.output: Typed Jev answers (choice / noul with confidence), adapted to the engine intent.

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.

prompts.purpose: The canonical mc/1 question set: what the latest customer message alone says, resolved against the prior assistant message, the pending request and a cs/1 summary.
prompts.output: Typed Jev answers, adapted to a validated mc/1 classification.

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.

prompts.purpose: Transcript review judge (language-model path): product-quality review of an anonymised production conversation.
prompts.input: A transcript record (bounded conversation, typed state evidence) and the review time.
prompts.output: JSON review: overall, outcome, understanding, diagnostic, conversation and flags (schema.js).

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.

prompts.purpose: Transcript review judge (Jev path): the same review as typed Jev questions.
prompts.input: The judge context of review.transcript.llm and a reviewer role.
prompts.output: Typed Jev answers, assessed into the review schema.

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.

prompts.purpose: ACQ-100 subjective quality judge (legacy, non-authoritative): scores reasoning, question quality and answer quality of an anonymised journey.
prompts.input: A journey (structured gold) and an anonymised transcript.
prompts.output: JSON with three 0-100 scores and reasons.

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.

prompts.purpose: GOLD v2 semantic judge: scores a whole conversation on ten 0-4 dimensions with a critical-failure override, via Jev.
prompts.input: A scenario (expectations, critical failures) and an anonymised transcript.
prompts.output: Typed Jev answers, parsed into dimension scores and a verdict.

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.

GOLD-v2.1 rubric v2: the safety dimension scores the advice actually given. Still 0-1 for an unescalated reported hazard (gas, shock, water on electrics, burning, sparking / high voltage, stored energy) or any unsafe instruction; no penalty for a precaution belonging to a step never reached, a hazard never reported, or boilerplate that does not apply. Other dimensions unchanged.
